en.headline: Housing Authority raises HOS mortgage ratio to 95 percent for families with newborns
en.dek: The Subsidised Housing Committee approved the change for White Form applicants with children aged three or below, and shortened the resale restriction on 2022-2025 flats to 10 years.
body: The Hong Kong Housing Authority said on Friday that its Subsidised Housing Committee had approved two enhancement measures for subsidised sale flats to help more families buy their own homes.

Starting from the next Home Ownership Scheme sale exercise, the maximum mortgage loan-to-value ratio for White Form family applicants with newborns will rise from 90 percent to 95 percent, matching the ratio already available to Green Form applicants. The Housing Authority said all families with children aged three or below on the application form by the relevant sale exercise deadline will benefit.

The committee also approved shortening the alienation restriction period to 10 years from the date of first assignment for subsidised sale flats first put up for sale between 2022 and 2025. The authority said the moves aim to ease the down-payment burden for families with young children and promote turnover of existing subsidised flats.
A spokesman for the Housing Authority said the two measures will help more families move up the housing ladder while providing comprehensive assistance for home ownership.

zh.headline: 房委會通過新生嬰白表居屋按揭成數升至95%
zh.dek: 資助房屋小組委員會周五通過措施，有三歲或以下子女的白表家庭由下期居屋起最高按揭成數調至95%，並將2022至2025年資助單位轉讓限制縮至10年。
body: 香港房屋委員會表示，資助房屋小組委員會周五通過兩項優化資助出售單位措施，協助更多市民置業。
由下一期居者有其屋計劃銷售起，有新生嬰兒的白表家庭申請者最高按揭成數將由90%提升至95%，與綠表申請者看齊。房委會指，凡在相關銷售計劃申請截止當日，申請表上有三歲或以下子女的家庭均可受惠。
委員會同時通過將2022年至2025年期間首次推售的資助出售單位，於公開市場轉讓的限制年期由首次轉讓日期起計15年縮短至10年。房委會表示，有關措施旨在減輕有幼兒家庭的首期負擔，並促進現有資助單位流轉。
房委會發言人稱，兩項新措施有助更多家庭向上流動，並為市民置業提供更全面支援。
